title: Children by Mission, Courtyard Fountain - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny mid-century family snapshot capturing four young children seated on a wooden bench built into a courtyard fountain wall. Two girls and a young boy in striped shirts and summer shorts look directly toward the camera, while a younger child playfully crawls along the stone ledge behind them. The background showcases a lush Spanish Colonial or Mission Revival setting featuring palm trees, flowering bushes, and tiled roofs, with other park visitors visible in the background under clear daylight.
